name: Biennale Yellow
summary: An art-biennale catalogue in motion: warm parchment, one deep indigo ink for all type and rules, huge Instrument Serif, and soft solar-yellow sun blooms that rise behind the page; words soak in from pale to ink without moving.

palette.use: paper: the ground of every frame; never white or grey
paper-deep: secondary paper, and the pale tone words soak in from
ink: ALL type and ALL rules; there's no second text colour
ink at 72% on paper: the page number only (proposed)
ink at 20% on paper: soft hairlines (proposed)
sun: bloom core, the yellow panel, block tiles (40-70%), the hard block under a key word
ember: only as a 15-22% counter-bloom in the corner opposite the sun; never a fill or text
bloom mid stop; light that has passed through

type.case: sentence case for display; labels uppercase with at least 0.16em tracking
type.emphasis: one italic key word, or a hard square sun block under one word; never bold, never a second colour

layout.empty: 55-60% of a frame is empty; the ledger is the one dense exception

banned: drop shadows, text shadows, rounded corners, bordered cards, borders over the hairline
a second text colour, bold Instrument Serif, inverted ink grounds (ink on yellow, never yellow on ink)
mono in body or display; any substitute face
crowding; a frame with no bloom or yellow surface; a headline blown edge to edge
ember as a fill or as text; ember stronger than 22%
rows of three cards; KPI grids
text that moves while it's read: words soak in where they stand and stay dead still
pulsing or drifting blooms: a bloom rises once and holds
